hypothesis: Changing the decision primitive from predict-the-side (closed 7 ways in this line) to a volatility-breakout BRACKET -- stop-entries armed at +/- b*sigma around next bar's open so the MARKET reveals the side, with the same TB exit structure (TP 2.5 sigma / SL 1.2 sigma / 288-bar horizon) whose oracle ceiling is proven huge on SOL -- converts the unpredictable-direction problem into a predictable-continuation problem: an ML gate only needs to forecast whether a triggered breakout continues (whipsaw avoidance), the mechanism the live SOL adaptive_squeeze strategy already monetizes at coarser granularity.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: All seven closed axes in this line share one structure: the model commits to a side at decision time from the panel state, and that directional forecast is what decorrelates on fresh data. The bracket primitive has never been tested here or registered as closed: side commitment is deferred to a market-confirmed stop trigger, and the learned component is a binary continuation gate on triggered setups -- a target whose base-rate economics are mechanically computable from data before any model is trained. btc_event_gate closed as real-but-not-actionable for lack of an execution primitive; the bracket IS an execution primitive, so that closure argues FOR this test, not against it.
research.retest_design: Same pinned panel, splits, costs, sizing, purge(288+W)+embargo(288). Stage 0 (no model): mechanical bracket replay on train+VAL for the closed grid b in {0.75,1.0} x trigger-window W in {6,12} bars -- record raw ungated economics AND the oracle-gated ceiling (perfect knowledge of TP-first outcomes); the line dies immediately if no (b,W) oracle ceiling is meaningfully positive after costs. Stage 1: per-(b,W) LightGBM binary gate P(TP-first | triggered setup) trained on mechanically-computed bracket outcome labels over purged train; VAL selection over (b,W) x gate threshold {0.45,0.50,0.55,0.60} requires VAL PnL > 0, >=15 trades, AND positive PnL in >=3 of the 4 VAL months (pre-registered stability screen against grid-size selection noise). ONE OOS read for the single selected config; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0. Ambiguous same-bar double-trigger bars are skipped; entry fills at stop price with the standard 10bps roundtrip; SL checked before TP within every bar including the entry bar.

model.candidate_architecture: mechanical +/-b*sigma stop-entry bracket with TB exits, gated by per-(b,W) LightGBM binary continuation classifier

selection.validation_pass_criteria: selected (b, W, threshold) must have VAL PnL > 0 with >=15 trades and positive PnL in >=3 of 4 VAL months; single OOS read; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0
